subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 22 updates

question: Should maintainers accept this grouped production dependency bump as one merge, or require narrower split dependency PRs first?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean and green, but grouped runtime/tooling dependency compatibility is a maintainer risk choice that CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept grouped bump
options.body: Merge after normal maintainer review, relying on the green CI and Vercel preview while accepting the grouped production dependency risk.

options.title: Split high-risk libraries
options.body: Ask for separate bumps for larger runtime surfaces such as Convex, TanStack, sharp, Resend, and CLI dependencies to narrow rollback scope.

recommendation.title: Accept grouped bump
recommendation.body: Merge after normal maintainer review, relying on the green CI and Vercel preview while accepting the grouped production dependency risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest package-file history match for current dependency baseline and release packaging context.
